basic_info.description: Incredibly charming and spacious condo with exquisite period detail in a prime Lower Pac Heights location! Situated in a boutique 8-unit building, this expansive unit marks all of the boxes and has a flexible floor plan and can be used as a 2 Bedroom. Enjoy the spacious updated kitchen with stainless steel appliances, large formal dining room with built in cabinets and box beam ceiling, living room with decorative fireplace, bedroom with a huge walk in closet and en suite bathroom, lovely oak hardwood floors, and abundant storage throughout. In addition there is separate laundry room with space for a home office. This beautiful home also features a large storage space and picturesque common garden and patio ideal for soaking up the sun or a BBQ with friends.This is an amazing Lower Pacific Heights location in the heart of the city and has easy access to public transit and downtown. It is walking distance to some of the city's best dining and shopping on Fillmore Street as well as Lafayette Park, Japan Town, and Whole Foods.
